# Home N More Studio

> Home N More Studio is a premium home decor, lifestyle, and luxury fragrance store based in Pakistan, offering home accents, candle stands, artisanal products, perfumes, and bakhoor.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://homenmorestudio.com/): Main storefront featuring Home N More Studio products, featured collections, and new arrivals.
- [Shop](https://homenmorestudio.com/shop): Browse the complete collection of home decor, candle holders, lifestyle products, fragrances, and related items.
- [About Us](https://homenmorestudio.com/aboutus): Learn about Home N More Studio, its design philosophy, artisanal approach, and brand story.
- [Contact Us](https://homenmorestudio.com/contact): Contact information, store details, and customer support.
- [Wishlist](https://homenmorestudio.com/wishlist): Customer wishlist and saved products.
- [Shipping Policy](https://homenmorestudio.com/shipping-policy): Delivery timelines, charges, and shipping guidelines.
- [Privacy Policy](https://homenmorestudio.com/privacy): Home N More Studio privacy policy.

## Shopping

- [Shop](https://homenmorestudio.com/shop): Main product catalog.
- Product pages use the URL pattern `https://homenmorestudio.com/product/{slug}`.

## Customer Services

- [Contact](https://homenmorestudio.com/contact): Customer support and store contact information.
- [Track Order](https://homenmorestudio.com/track-order): Order tracking page.
- [My Profile](https://homenmorestudio.com/myprofile): Customer account and profile page.
- [Checkout](https://homenmorestudio.com/checkout): Customer checkout page.

## Brand Information

- Brand Name: Home N More Studio
- Business Type: Home Decor, Lifestyle & Luxury Fragrance Store
- Country: Pakistan
- Primary Products: Home decor, candle stands, candle holders, artisanal products, lifestyle products, luxury fragrances, and bakhoor.
